_comment: Alias 'coder-2' -> qwen3:8b on endpoint B. Execution role: must create files and run commands, so native tool calling is mandatory and was verified with endpoints/toolcheck.py. The alias is resolved in endpoints/config.yml; this file never names a server. Note: qwen3 cannot disable thinking via /v1, which costs ~1156 completion tokens on a multi-tool turn. api_key is the literal throwaway loopback value, NOT os.environ/: OpenHands does not expand environment references in this field. Sending the literal string makes LiteLLM attempt a virtual-key lookup, which without a database returns 400 'No connected db.' on every turn while /v1/models still answers - it looks like a model fault. This key is safe to commit only because every port is bound to 127.0.0.1; it must be changed if the proxy is ever exposed.
